speaker: marco
line: Do you remember when we couldn't keep our hands off each other?

speaker: luna
line: Yeah... that was a long time ago.

speaker: marco
line: What happened to us? Like... it's not that I don't want you. I just... I don't feel that fire anymore.

speaker: luna
line: Maybe the fire was never about us. Maybe it was about the newness... the chase.

speaker: marco
line: That's what scares me. Because before you... I always moved on when things got boring. New person, new rush.

speaker: luna
line: And now you can't do that. So you're stuck... with just me.

speaker: marco
line: I tried the tantra thing. Slowing down. Being present. But my mind keeps comparing... to before.

speaker: luna
line: You know what I realized? I didn't fall in love with you. I fell in love with my idea of you.

speaker: luna
line: I built this version of you in my head. And now I'm mad because the real you doesn't match.

speaker: marco
line: So we were both chasing something that was never real.

speaker: luna
line: Yeah. And maybe that's okay. Maybe now we get to actually meet each other... for the first time.
